chapter: Honors, Gibson and Dorsey late years
title: New Year's Eve firecracker prank
summary: Leeman and Shavers set off a firecracker in the alley below the dressing room, bringing police into the theatre until Dorsey scolds the band.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: And I must get to New Years Eve, an incident that happened that might be worth reminiscing, and worth a chuckle. Charlie and I did a lot of drinking together, we were both into it pretty good, and between shows, we used to fool around with pranks here and there and so forth, and up in the dressing room, someplace in one of my travels out west, I used to carry some two-inch salutes - firecrackers. And sitting in the dressing room, I thought it would be
beautiful, this is New Year's Eve -- I opened the window and I told Charlie here we go, and I lit one of these two inch salutes.

Well, it went down -- there was an alleyway and this salute dropped down in the alleyway, and of course that amplified the sound, it was like an echo chamber, and went it went off, it sounded like a cannon. And we're sitting there laughing and all of a sudden, the doors burst open all through with cops and their guns -- and they went through the theatre. But I mean, there was a call out, a cop in distress, and they went into Tommy's room and Tommy dispelled them and said nobody fired a gun up here.

It seems that the police had an alert out for a killer who had escaped from jail, and the policeman that set the alarm off was calling in on the phone, a police phone, and was down in that alley. I imagine he was quite surprised and a bit jumpy.

Anyway, Tommy knew it was a damn prank, so he called the whole band together -- he used to love to do that, bawl us all out and said, "I don't know who's responsible" and I guess I was always a dead giveaway because I blush very easily, and that was the end of that incident.
